name: Santiago Ramón y Cajal
summary: Pen-and-India-ink histology figures from Histologie du système nerveux (1909): Golgi-black neurons with branching dendrites, fibre tracts, letter labels with leaders.

cells.about: a few whole Golgi-black nerve cells and glia, dendrites branching to spines, axons wandering across a pale field

section.about: a low-power map of a whole region of a section: fibre streams as parallel lines, stippled cell groups, the tissue's own edge

public_summary: His drawings of the nervous system (Golgi-stained neurons, glia, the retina, the cerebellum, sections of the brainstem and spinal cord) in pen and India ink, and photographs he took.
